chunks: "Three things demolish the body and may even kill: eating dried meat intermittently, entering the bathhouse on a full stomach, and marrying an elderly woman."
And it is narrated: "Intimacy upon fullness of the stomach."

key_terms.الْبِطْنَةِ: fullness of the stomach or overeating

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about practices that harm the body?
ai.summary: This hadith presents cautions about practices described as harmful to bodily well-being. It also includes a related report warning against intimacy while in a state of fullness.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.300 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"There are three things that can weaken and potentially destroy the body: eating dried meat excessively, entering the bathhouse on a full stomach, and marrying an elderly woman."
It is also reported: "Intimacy on a full stomach."
